1.label: very_easy
1.summary: Dock one crate on a 7 × 5 warehouse through a 6 to 10 move route. Controls lag by one command and the queued direction remains visible.
1.natural_language: Dock the crate. Every direction executes one command late; use EXECUTE QUEUE to run the last one.
